newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico says free EU trade at least 2 yrs away.
newsitem.headline: Mexico says free EU trade at least 2 yrs away.

text.p: Mexico is at least two or three years away from a completed free trade agreement with European Union, Trade Minister Herminio Blanco said Tuesday.

"Accord negotiations will begin in 1998 and it will definitely be difficult and complicated, simply considering that the European Union has 15 member countries," Blanco told reporters. "We calculate at least some two or three years (before the accord is completed.)"
Mexico and the European Union have been in talks to create a trade pact to boost trans-Atlantic commerce.
In April Mexican officials agreed to a human rights clause that encouraged EU officials to move ahead in negotations.
Blanco said required legal documents for the trade accord will be discussed in a June 10-11 meeting in Brussels.
